insight: Founded in 2020 and operated by Swiss company OmniSale GmbH.
name: LALAL.AI
tagline: AI vocal remover and stem separation, built for pro-level quality.
description: An AI audio service that removes vocals and splits any track into clean stems — vocals, drums, bass, guitars, piano, and more — using transformer-based separation models. It adds voice cleaning, echo and reverb removal, and lead/backing vocal separation. Available on the web, desktop, native iOS and Android apps, a DAW plugin, and a developer API.
edge: Cleanest isolated-vocal extraction with the widest instrument set (piano, strings, wind) and a production-ready API.
pros: Web, desktop, iOS, Android, DAW plugin
cons: Max-quality burns 2x+ the audio length in minutes
Bleed increases in dense chorus sections

references.title: AI Stem Separation Tools 2026: LALAL.AI vs Moises vs RipX
